image.description: Capture of the interface: project image path or brand asset. All step coordinates are fractions of this image

frame.description: Frame around the capture; default browser

url.description: Address shown in the browser bar; only with frame browser

name.description: Name of the region as the dev gave it, e.g. "Tarjeta Plan Propio"

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of the image width

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of the image height

w.description: Width as a fraction of the image width

h.description: Height as a fraction of the image height

source.description: given: the dev provided it; measured: the producer measured it on the capture

measuredBy.description: Who measured the box, only when source is measured

measuredAt.description: ISO instant of the measurement, only when source is measured

boxes.description: Measured boxes of the capture, copied from the brief image; steps point at them by name with box

autoZoom.description: The studio camera follows the steps (zooms into each one and pans between them) when the scene has no zoom step; set false to keep the full capture in view

action.description: move: cursor travels to x,y. click: cursor clicks at x,y. type: text is typed inside the field box. highlight: outlines the box. callout: speech bubble with text anchored at x,y. zoom: magnifies the region and returns

box.description: Name of a measured box of the capture (see boxes). Use it instead of x,y,w,h whenever the brief gives the box: move, click and callout go to its center, type, highlight and zoom cover it

x.description: Horizontal position over the capture, 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge. For boxes (type, highlight, zoom) it is the left edge of the box. Omit when box is set

y.description: Vertical position over the capture, 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge. For boxes it is the top edge of the box. Omit when box is set

w.description: Box width as a fraction of the capture width (type, highlight, zoom)

h.description: Box height as a fraction of the capture height (type, highlight, zoom)

text.description: Required for type (the text typed) and callout (the bubble text)

at.description: Seconds from the scene start when the step happens; used only when there is no cue

emphasis.description: Words to stress; recorded for engines that support it, ignored by Piper.

direction.description: How this voice-over line is delivered: pace, energy, pause after the line and words to stress. Omit it for the voice default

titleStyle.description: How the scene headline enters: by letter, word or line, rising out of a mask, or scrambled. Omit it and the studio rotates it, never repeating the two previous scenes

exit.description: How the scene leaves the frame. Never repeat the exit of the previous scene; use wipe, iris or slide-left before a new chapter. Omit it and the studio rotates exits on its own; the last scene always fades out

accent.description: Words shown right AFTER the title (or tagline) in the accent gradient; never repeat words of the title

buttonCue.description: Prefix of a word spoken in this scene voice line; the element appears when the voice says it
